description: This line plot is named Loss Ratio w.r.t FLOPs. The x-axis plots the number of iterations on a linear scale from 0 to 120000. The y-axis plots the loss ratio on a linear scale from 2.5 to 3.3. The line plot shows the loss ratio of different methods to that of Vanilla with respect to FLOPs.
